_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 69: 7-12 May 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of two in Rome right outside of it in the days ahead and says the walls of the Vatican will crack, that he still stands by everything the Lord gives him, and that he has to remind himself of what he was shown, dating something to May 5th.
mentions.quote: the walls of the Vatican will crack
mentions.falsify_match: Structural damage to the Vatican walls, which would be reported immediately.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Concrete and visible if it happens, but with no date attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was 2023 but people get impatient like a microwave and think that because it did not happen in the first two weeks it is a false prophecy, and answers that he did not give a prophecy but gave them a vision, adding that they can call it whatever they want.
mentions.quote: I didn't give a prophecy. I gave you a vision
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the definitional move the whole corpus rests on: what is said is a vision rather than a prophecy, so the test for a false prophet does not apply to it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they injected the rats and asks whether they have the cartoon drawing, and someone explains they made the chart with this and that so it would be something to pull from, an attempt to bring all the prophetic words and visions together.
mentions.quote: I made the chart so that it would be something you can pull from
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, but notable: they keep their own index of the words, which is the same undertaking as this database.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that if it worked for the election last time in 2020 it will work again, that they wanted to control the economy for agenda 2030 and for what is coming, and that he saw them release something and then say the money is bad and you cannot have it.
mentions.quote: I saw them release something and then they say the money's bad
mentions.falsify_match: A release followed by restrictions on cash.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The 2020 comparison supplies the template rather than a date.

mentions.claim_text: He says no, down, that they will start to talk about going to outer space again, that there will be a new space race coming on April 4th if they did that, and that he said they would be talking about putting a moon base on the moon.
mentions.quote: There'll be a new space race come on April 4th
mentions.falsify_match: A space race and a lunar base becoming public discussion, which the May NASA announcement supplies.
mentions.falsify_miss: The April 4th date is stated conditionally, if they did that, which softens it.

mentions.claim_text: He imagines someone saying they are watching some bald headed guy on YouTube and want to give their heart more to Jesus by getting plugged in there, and tells them to volunteer and do whatever they need to get themselves around new people.
mentions.quote: get yourself around new people
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it points them toward a local congregation rather than the channel.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it will shake you to wake you up, asks what he told them on January 1, and reports the Lord saying 2026 will be the year of 1 Corinthians 5:5 because he is going to shake the church and the leadership in the church, and that there will be people who are here at the beginning of it.
mentions.quote: I am going to shake the church and leadership in the church
mentions.falsify_match: Church leaders falling publicly through 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Five months into the year the claim is still being restated rather than pointed at anything.

mentions.claim_text: He says what a transition it will be, that for 1 Corinthians 5:5 they will see a shaking that will awaken to bring the bride by his side, and says he touched that lightly but wants them to see this.
mentions.quote: a shaking that will awaken to bring the bride by my side
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the shaking is the mechanism, so hardship confirms it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it is coming to full fruit and points to what they are seeing with the anonymous man, then to what they are seeing in the church, that the Lord said they will see the same things with the church, big churches, churches in California and TV stations.
mentions.quote: What we're seeing with this anonymous. Then we're seeing stuff in the church
mentions.falsify_match: Named church figures falling and broadcasters closing.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He is pointing at things already unfolding as the fulfilment.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is cleaning his church but it will not just be about the church because judgment begins in the house of the Lord first, and that because of this he will also clean the world and they will start to see the manifestations of it in 2026, naming politicians.
mentions.quote: I will also clean the world and you'll start to see the manifestations in 2026
mentions.falsify_match: Public disclosures involving politicians during 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Something is exposed every year, so ordinary news satisfies it.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is the year of 2026 and 1 Corinthians 5:5, that he did not play that and they can play it, and that this is when he first heard it, during the Christmas for the White House, with a shaking in the churches.
mentions.quote: This is when I first heard it, during the Christmas for the White House
mentions.falsify_match: The original telling of the verse claim is dated to Christmas and is in this corpus, so the recall can be checked against it.
mentions.falsify_miss: The Christmas recording does not contain it.

mentions.claim_text: He says to be all in and stop playing church, that he does not want to be on the wrong side of this or of the anger of the Lord when people are doing wrong, and that judgment begins in the house of the Lord first and he is cleaning up his bride.
mentions.quote: be all in and stop playing church
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays at length in tongues, with the words many will come to me surfacing in English, then that the dead you will raise and you will see, repeating the dead you will raise, and multiple.
mentions.quote: The dead you will raise. The dead you will raise
mentions.falsify_match: A verified resurrection, which would be extraordinary evidence.
mentions.falsify_miss: None verified. The tongues section is described rather than transcribed.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces what he saw concerning the beef in the days ahead, asks what day it was and settles on June 27th of 2025, and says this is what he saw coming concerning the beef, that there is coming a controlled something.
mentions.quote: This is what I saw coming concerning the beef
mentions.falsify_match: Beef supply controls or shortages, with the June 2025 telling in this corpus to check against.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such controls.

mentions.claim_text: They cue up a longer interview and he says he wants to hear him and has not seen any of this, and the clip gives two examples, the first being that people eat too much meat and if they were to cut down.
mentions.quote: I haven't seen any of this, baby
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: someone else's interview, played as confirmation.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: The clip continues that people could be made allergic to meat, that the speaker can describe the mechanism, that this is something achievable through human engineering to address big world problems, and mentions ticks.
mentions.quote: allergic to meat. we can do that through human engineering
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a played interview offered as confirmation of the beef word. Not his words.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether that is it and whether they have the things because the virus is the most important thing of the night, and they agree he will go over it rather than play all of it.
mentions.quote: the virus is the most important thing of the night
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: running order.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He describes a president saying my fellow Americans we are stopping the spread, says it is during his term, and that when he had this Trump was not president but Joe Biden was, and that he said in the days ahead Trump will be president and will stand behind the podium and say it.
mentions.quote: when I had this, Trump was not president. Joe Biden was
mentions.falsify_match: A presidential address about stopping the spread during this term, with the original telling under the previous administration in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such address. The claim to have called it before the change of administration is the checkable part.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is getting emails asking whether this is the virus, that he did not think it was coming in 2026 and believes this is a test run, that he prays, but that he heard the Lord say you will not stop it and you can only lessen it.
mentions.quote: You won't stop it. You can lessen it
mentions.falsify_match: An epidemic that arrives despite the prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. This is the clearest statement that prayer cannot prevent this one, only reduce it, which removes the usual escape and leaves the claim standing on the timing alone.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is the end of 2027 going into 2028 and that is what he has always seen, asks whether it can be delayed and says he does not know, and that when he saw on the news that it was rats he thought oh no, it should not be this year.
mentions.quote: The end of 2027 going into 2028. That's what I've always seen
mentions.falsify_match: An epidemic in that window.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing in it. Always seen is not accurate to the record: the plague window has moved through 2026, 2027 and 2028 across at least seven tellings since November.
